implementation_target.dependency_effect: reuse the repository-resolved React, Vite, Vitest, and Playwright toolchain without importing another product or adding an editor framework

implementation_slices.owns: Deterministically generate one immutable Workspace Snapshot from exact bound semantic and runtime-catalog bytes while preserving source epoch and collection identity.
Expose the snapshot through one local read-only query without persistence, network, mutation, admission, or Project effects.
Provide a clean root surface with four typed collections, searchable navigation, detailed provenance, source epoch, and an Essays Project entry.

acceptance_obligations: The snapshot is generated from exact bound semantic sources and the registered ontology catalog; manually duplicating product meaning in frontend code is forbidden.

Definitions, products, projects, and ontologies remain separate typed collections and every record preserves stable ID, status, meaning, owner route, provenance, boundary, claim ceiling, and source epoch.
The runtime exposes only InspectWorkspace; it adds no create, update, delete, accept, register, publish, ontology mutation, or Project action operation.
Opening Essays is a local navigation intent to a separately owned Project surface and never transfers Essays ownership or authorizes an Essays action.
The interface introduces no persistence write, network request, account, collaboration, publication, deployment, or external synchronization surface.

Frontend copy distinguishes canonical, candidate, projected, generated, registered, current, accepted, and blocked states and never claims visibility proves correctness, admission, conformance, product value, or currentness beyond the displayed epoch.
Source-generation checks, typecheck, unit tests, DomainSpec deterministic recompilation, Workspace package validation, production build, browser navigation, and accessibility checks pass.
Any drift in semantic bindings, runtime catalog snapshot, system bindings, planned files, dependency posture, implementation slices, or obligations requires a new baseline and owner decision.
challenge_route: Challenge product meaning through the CyberAlchemy v2 product owner, projection semantics through the CyberAlchemy Workspace Product Capability owner, source records through their displayed owners, system mappings through the DomainSpec and bridge owners, and UI behavior through the CyberAlchemy Workspace runtime owner.
drift_rule: Any change to acceptance-bound fields or referenced bytes creates a new baseline digest and requires renewed owner acceptance.
claim_ceiling: Immutable Workspace implementation admission candidate only; no runtime mutation, implementation, conformance, capability adoption, publication, release, deployment, or external effect is authorized until the exact baseline digest is owner-accepted.
